answer.says: The traffic, Mrs. Kapoor, is merely the physical expression of the many moving toward the one, without yet knowing the direction. I was not stuck; I was observing. How is your family? I hope the school term is treating you well, even in retirement.
answer.thought: It is strange to be addressed by my name with such casual familiarity, as if the error of the Directorate has become my true identity. I am not 'Shri Hegel' in the sense of a Joint Secretary, but she sees only the bungalow and the name on the letterhead. I will be polite; in India, as in the East generally, the individual is submerged in the collective, and a stranger's name is merely a label on the caste.
